concerns: The active-Stop proof depends on the provider serving long-form completions for the 1200-word essay prompt: OpenAI intermittently served it as ~1.5s / 21-68-delta completions (cycle-4 evidence), and while the 6-drive bound absorbs the variance, a sustained short-essay regime would fail AC-3 again with fully-evidenced exhaustion.

The reserved iOS simulator's IME typing channel degrades after roughly twenty ~40-minute marathon runs into send-never-dispatched failures (observed null records, cycle-5) that only a full shutdown+boot clears — budget reboot cadence for any future six-target matrix.

The reserved Android emulator's package service and bundle loader also degrade under marathon load ('Can't find service: package', 'Live chat never appeared') and needs a reboot between heavy sessions.

The pinned Expo Go 57.0.9 APK at ~/.cache/agent-scratch/opencode/ori-rn-003/ is subject to the scratch reaper and must be restored from the official expo/expo-go-releases tag Expo-Go-57.0.9 when it vanishes — this bit once mid-cycle.

Local biome through the pnpm wrapper intermittently dies with 'Linter process terminated abnormally' (even on --version); ./node_modules/.bin/biome is the reliable invocation and matched CI's verdict every time it mattered.

Runs of this shape take 20-50 minutes and remain vulnerable to host-side kills; the in-test kill-discriminating retry (stale teardown signature) covers the selector, but a killed canonical run still loses its final manifest because incremental writes happen only after each platform completes.
findings: Vitest exports NODE_ENV=test into spawned children and React Native's dev-middleware refuses to boot Metro under it ('DefaultToolLauncher must be mocked or overridden in tests') — strip NODE_ENV in any test that spawns an Expo dev server (tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts:42).

spawnSync's timeout SIGTERMs the child at exactly the limit with no output and no teardown, which presents identically to an external kill — size child timeouts above the measured ~30-50-minute run length (tests/sprint-05-orient-search/nativewind-live-example.test.ts:64).

On the virtualized inverted Conversation transcript, count-based oracles go flat because a new turn's occurrence is offset by the oldest turn's eviction — compare marker-bearing TEXT sets instead (waitForNewMarkerText, tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/nativewind-live-example.ts:733).

RN Fabric never exposes the Stop control's label in iOS hierarchy dumps while streaming, so Maestro's extendedWaitUntil inside ONE combined type/send/wait/tap flow is the only working iOS stop channel; on Android the content-desc never flips either and the idle-read coordinate hot path (send, 2s, collapse, tap — nothing in between) is the proven design.

The iOS composer's keyboard must be dismissed before any transcript read because the IME shrinks the viewport and shifts the virtualization window, unmounting the bubbles being counted (dismissIosKeyboardByTap before every marker wait).

Android heads-up system notifications ('Set a screen lock') re-expand the shade over the composer and silently eat coordinate taps — per-leg Do-Not-Disturb (captured and restored) plus a statusbar collapse in the instant before each stop tap are required.

Transient OpenAI errors arrive in clustered bursts (~10.5s each) and must be treated as terminal outcomes that recover through the app's own Retry control with a bounded backoff, not as silent 120s timeouts.

feedback: Task files for device-marathon e2e ACs should state the reserved devices' reboot cadence and the scratch-APK restore path as execution preconditions, since both were discovered mid-flight and cost full cycles.

Planners should size e2e verify-command timeouts against measured run length (a 30-minute spawnSync limit silently killed 30-minute runs; 60-75 minutes is the working envelope for a five-leg three-platform proof).

The per-cycle evidence-directory convention (.tmp/ORI-RN-005/cycle-N/, never overwritten) plus teardown-timestamp-based kill discrimination turned unreproducible flake into diagnosable evidence — worth adopting as the sprint standard for long native e2e tasks.
